excluded_modules.render_vulkan: GPU implementation/public device API; image and synchronization tests qualify this separately.

outside_roots.apps: Executable entry points and viewer UI are outside the non-GPU core library measurement.
outside_roots.tests: Test harnesses are instrumented but excluded from production coverage.
outside_roots.build, .deps, system headers: Vendored dependencies, generated bindings and standard libraries are excluded.

platform_policy: All compiled platform branches stay in the denominator, including process, locks and atomic publication. Inactive preprocessor branches are not measured on this host.
